text: Gold dropped about 2.4% to roughly $4,040, its lowest in more than two months and almost 6% down on the month.
Silver fell nearly 6% to about $54.50, so the gold/silver ratio jumped to around 74: silver is taking the bigger hit.
The 10-year yield fell about 14 bp to below 5%, its biggest one-day drop since August 2025, even with oil higher.
Brent pushed toward $112 after renewed attacks on shipping around Hormuz, reviving talk of a Fed hike next week.
The yen strengthened, USD/JPY down about 0.8% to near 156.8, as BoJ officials keep signalling more tightening.
Nasdaq fell about 2.1% and the S&P 500 about 1.3%, after chip stocks in Asia (Tokyo Electron, SK Hynix) lost around 6% overnight.
